# InterviewCrack

> InterviewCrack is a browser-based interview practice app with a virtual interview room, quizzes, audio practice, and video practice. No account or InterviewCrack subscription is required. Generating questions requires your own Gemini API key; provider charges or limits may apply. You can also import prepared questions.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://product4u.github.io/interviewcrack-app/): Features, costs, and privacy details.
- [Practice guides](https://product4u.github.io/interviewcrack-app/guides/): Interview preparation resources.
- [Mock interview at home](https://product4u.github.io/interviewcrack-app/guides/mock-interview-at-home.html): A repeatable practice session and review checklist.
- [React interview questions](https://product4u.github.io/interviewcrack-app/guides/react-interview-questions.html): Questions, explanations, and follow-up exercises.
- [STAR interview answers](https://product4u.github.io/interviewcrack-app/guides/star-interview-answers.html): A worked example and a planning worksheet.
- [Practice app](https://product4u.github.io/interviewcrack-app/app/): Interactive practice; JavaScript required.

## Data and limitations
Practice history is stored in the same browser and device. Export results and recordings separately for a backup. Gemini receives the key and prompt during generation. Browser speech services may process audio online. The landing preview does not record visitors. Practice does not guarantee interview outcomes.

This optional discovery file does not replace the website, robots.txt, or sitemap and does not grant special ranking or citation eligibility.
